headline: Friday, November 13 — the storm lands, 96% rain, IOP group at 9

sections.lead: The big one arrives: rain 96%, high 62, low 49, south wind 16 mph with gusts to 32.
items: Hour by hour: 7am 58 with 15% rain chance, 9am 61 at 51%, 10am to 1pm the wall (87 to 99%, thunderstorms possible), 3pm tapering to 26%, 7pm mostly clear, 10pm 34%
Best dry window: before 9am and after 3pm
Week: Sat cloudy 63/49, Sun showers 65% 62/51, Mon sunny 59/44, Tue partly sunny 59/44, Wed heavy rain 75% 54/46, Thu sunny 54/42
If anything errands-shaped needs doing outside, do it early or tonight

sections.lead: Heads-down Capricorn day: the Moon moved into the sign of checklists and structure overnight, and the mood outside matches, so today is a stay-in-and-clear-the-list day.
items: Plain read: structure feels good today instead of like a chore, and your Mercury support is exact, so reading and forms go as smoothly as they get this week
The Moon also lines up easy with your ascendant, so the day tends to move in step with you
The Mercury retrograde caveat holds, one last week: read each form twice before you submit
How to use it: Granite forms and iron in the morning lull, IOP group on Zoom through the storm's peak

Details: Moon Capricorn 12.3, waxing crescent (50 deg elongation); Sun trine natal Mercury (orb 0.0, exact); Moon trine natal Ascendant (orb 2.7); Venus retro conjunct natal Moon (orb 1.9); Neptune retro trine natal Venus (orb 0.7); Pluto sextile natal Moon (orb 1.0); Mercury retro square natal Sun (orb 2.4); Saturn retro trine natal Sun (orb 2.4); first quarter Moon Monday

sections.lead: Zero new construction-dispatch leads overnight; boards quiet on the pre-dawn pass.
items: Nothing new on the Job Hunt tab; the 3pm sweep takes another look

sections.lead: Quiet night, no new mail of any kind.
items: Nothing new from Granite since Tuesday, so the four onboarding tasks still look open in Workday, Candidate Home, My Tasks: Edit Licenses, Photography Release, Veteran Status Identification, Granite App Login
No interview requests

sections.lead: A rare piece of good money news from City Hall.
items: Antioch closed fiscal year 2025-26 with a preliminary $1.8 million surplus, mostly because spending came in under projections, though the city still projects a deficit ahead
The five-county transit sales tax still leads at 61.4% of counted votes; it funds BART and AC Transit
Antioch police are still investigating the two weekend hit-and-runs that hurt two pedestrians

sections.lead: Storm outside, one long Zoom inside, and it is an iron morning.
items: Easy win: take the iron supplement with breakfast, and Friday's 9am text reminder has your back
9:00 AM to noon: IOP Online Group Visit, Zoom, three hours; reschedule line 925-777-6300
Between: the four Granite onboarding tasks in Workday, 10 to 15 minutes total
Routine continues through the storm: 10am apply run, 3pm construction-dispatch sweep, 5pm site check, 7pm apply run

sections.lead: Tony's and the Family calendars are clear for Friday.
items: Nothing on either calendar
